findings.en_sentence: A crest is present on top of the snout, which does not have a rounded tip.
findings.es_sentence: Sobre el hocico se observa una cresta que no presenta un extremo redondeado.
findings.problem: Source says the base of a crest is visible on the snout and does not quite reach the snout's rounded tip; the text says the crest (or snout) has no rounded tip. eswiki already garbled this.
findings.correct: The base of a crest is visible on top of the snout; it stops just short of the rounded snout tip. / En el hocico se aprecia la base de una cresta que no llega a alcanzar su punta redondeada.

findings.en_sentence: The fossils were found in brown clay from the Wessex Formation of the Wealden Group, dating to the Early Cretaceous (Barremian), approximately 130 million years ago.
findings.es_sentence: Los fósiles aparecieron en arcilla marrón de la Formación Wessex, perteneciente al Grupo Wealden, y corresponden al Cretácico Inferior (barremiense), hace aproximadamente 130 millones de años.
findings.problem: 130 Ma comes from eswiki and is wrong: the Barremian is c. 125.8-121.4 Ma (130 Ma is Hauterivian). Contradicts the page's own 125 Ma and 125.77-121.4 Ma sentences.
findings.correct: ... (Barremian), about 125 million years ago. / ... (Barremiense), hace unos 125 millones de años.
findings.checked_in: enwiki Discovery and naming (says 125 Ma); eswiki Descripción (says 130); F011 vs F002/F025; ICS chart

findings.en_sentence: The parent group for Caulkicephalus is Ornithocheiridae.
findings.es_sentence: El grupo superior de Caulkicephalus es la familia Ornithocheiridae.
findings.problem: Stated as current fact right after saying 2019 studies moved it to Anhangueridae, and the page opens calling it an anhanguerid; it is PBDB's outdated placement and also repeats the describers' Ornithocheiridae sentence.
findings.correct: Drop it, or frame it: 'The Paleobiology Database still lists it under Ornithocheiridae.' / 'La Paleobiology Database aún lo incluye en Ornithocheiridae.'

findings.en_sentence: Small teeth were located in a compressed area of the snout ending in a wide tip with large teeth, forming a "trap" generally believed to be an adaptation for catching elusive prey like fish.
findings.es_sentence: Dientes pequeños se situaban en una zona comprimida del hocico que terminaba en una punta ancha con dientes grandes, creando una «trampa» generalmente considerada una adaptación para atrapar presas elusivas como peces.
findings.problem: Same fact as the preceding 'prey grab' sentence (enwiki and eswiki versions of one statement), presented as if 'prey grab' and 'trap' were two different features.
findings.correct: Keep one sentence: the smaller teeth sat in a constriction of the snout behind a broad tip bearing larger teeth (a 'prey grab'), usually read as an adaptation for catching slippery prey such as fish.
findings.checked_in: enwiki Description; eswiki Descripción; F006, F020

findings.en_sentence: A constriction in the snout with larger teeth at the broad end, known as a "prey grab," is interpreted as an adaptation for catching slippery prey like fish.
findings.es_sentence: Una estrechadura en el hocico, con dientes más grandes en el extremo ancho y conocida como «presa», se interpreta como una adaptación para capturar presas resbaladizas como peces.
findings.problem: 'prey grab' rendered as «presa» (= prey), meaningless and clashing with 'presas' later in the sentence; 'estrechadura' is a rare term (standard: estrechamiento).
findings.correct: Un estrechamiento del hocico, tras un extremo ancho con dientes más grandes (un «agarre de presas»), se interpreta como una adaptación para capturar presas resbaladizas como peces.

findings.en_sentence: The genus name combines "Caulkhead", a traditional nickname for Wight island residents, with the Greek word kephale meaning "head".
findings.es_sentence: El nombre del género une «Caulkhead», mote habitual entre los habitantes de Wight, con el término griego kephale, que significa «cabeza».
findings.problem: The name does not combine 'Caulkhead' with kephale (that would mean head twice); it renders 'Caulkhead' as caulk + Greek kephale. 'Wight island residents' is unidiomatic; ES 'mote habitual entre los habitantes' means a nickname used among them, not for them.
findings.correct: The genus name renders 'Caulkhead', a traditional nickname for Isle of Wight residents, using the Greek kephale, 'head'. / El nombre del género traduce «Caulkhead», apodo tradicional de los habitantes de la isla de Wight, con el griego kephale, «cabeza».
findings.checked_in: enwiki Discovery and naming; eswiki Descripción; F013

findings.en_sentence: David Martill estimated that Caulkicephalus had a wingspan of nearly five meters.
findings.es_sentence: David Martill calculó que Caulkicephalus poseía una envergadura de casi cinco metros.
findings.problem: Sources say about/around 5 m ('cerca de' = approximately), not 'nearly' (just under).
findings.correct: ... a wingspan of about five metres. / ... una envergadura de unos cinco metros.
findings.checked_in: enwiki Description ('around 5 meters'); eswiki ('cerca de cinco metros'); F024

findings.en_sentence: Caulkicephalus is a genus of anhanguerid pterosaur found on the Isle of Wight off the coast of England.
findings.es_sentence: Caulkicephalus es un género de pterosaurio anhanguerino hallado en la isla de Wight, frente a la costa de Inglaterra.

findings.en_sentence: The fourth tooth pair matched the first in size, while the fifth, sixth, and seventh pairs were notably smaller, less than half the size, a feature referenced in the species name.
findings.es_sentence: El cuarto par de dientes coincidía en tamaño con el primero, mientras que los quintos, sextos y séptimos eran notablemente más pequeños, menos de la mitad, una característica citada en el nombre de la especie.
findings.problem: Pluralised ordinals 'los quintos, sextos y séptimos' are ungrammatical here (each is one pair).
findings.correct: ... mientras que los pares quinto, sexto y séptimo eran notablemente más pequeños, de menos de la mitad de tamaño, rasgo al que alude el nombre de la especie.

findings.en_sentence: The time range for Caulkicephalus is the Barremian, from 125.77 to 121.4 million years ago.
findings.es_sentence: El rango temporal de Caulkicephalus abarca el barremiense, desde hace 125,77 hasta 121,4 millones de años.
findings.problem: Stage name lowercased ('barremiense') while 'Cretácico Inferior' is capitalised; chronostratigraphic units take capitals (Barremiense). Same in the Wessex Formation sentence.
findings.correct: ... abarca el Barremiense, desde hace 125,77 hasta 121,4 millones de años.
